IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Higher Education & Workforce Development (originally sponsored by Senators Haugen, Harper, Shin, and Delvin)

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the University Center of North Puget Sound.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to expanding opportunities in higher education innorth Puget Sound; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Changes or modifications of the UniversityCenter of North Puget Sound, including: (1) Creation of any new degree programs offered by a four-yearinstitution; (2) Purchase or lease of major off-campus facilities by theUniversity Center; (3) Creation of a new, or major modification to the existing,management structure of the University Center; (4) New degree programs and creation of off-campus programs by anindependent college or university in collaboration with the UniversityCenter; or (5) Applied baccalaureate degree programs developed at theUniversity Center under RCW 28B.50.810shall only be considered after the higher education coordinating boardconducts a needs assessment and viability determination, under RCW p. 1 SSB 563628B.76.230, and presents a positive recommendation to the governor andthe legislature.
